_comment: Toy 2-master canonical connection on the P4_J23 3-letter alphabet, demonstrating the coproduct/Disc cut. dF = ε(A_s dlog s + A_t dlog t + A_st dlog(s+t))·F. Master m1 only couples through {L_s,L_st}; m2 only through {L_t,L_st}. So coproduct restricts m1's last letter to {L_s,L_st}, m2's to {L_t,L_st}.
